description: Same move as py-reexport-stable-api, but side A FORGOT to update pkg/__init__: side A is self-inconsistent BEFORE the merge. The shim error exists in the A-alone state, so the break is not merge-induced; a plain CI typecheck of branch A alone would catch it.
notes: Oracle policy: TP requires the break to be NEW under the merge (interaction-subtracted). A-side self-breakage is a named FP category (fp_a_self_inconsistent) - SEMLock flagging it is a useful warning, tracked separately as consumer impact, never counted as precision.
